methods.label: Division fact
methods.levelReason: The calculation is an elementary division fact. The accompanying observation about improper fractions is within Grade 5.

needsNewNodes.name: Evaluating exact whole-number quotients
needsNewNodes.description: Evaluate the whole-number quotient of a nonnegative whole-number dividend by a positive whole-number divisor when the dividend is a multiple of the divisor, without prescribing a calculation method.
needsNewNodes.reason: cnm_p044 and cnm_p046 prescribe multiplication-fact methods. cnm_p043 covers division meaning, while cnm_p083 concerns written division of two- or three-digit dividends. None precisely covers this route-neutral calculation target.

limitations: The assessed target has no suitable catalog ID and remains pending catalog addition.
candidate.changeReason: 8 ÷ 8 = 1, and an improper fraction with equal positive numerator and denominator equals 1. Retain both correct, sufficient statements verbatim; repair only the route-specific assessed annotation and report the missing target.

review.mathematicalCheck: \(8\times1=8\), establishing the quotient 1. The corresponding fraction \(8/8\) is improper and equals 1, so the accompanying observation is valid. The explanation is sufficient.
review.levelCheck: The division fact and improper-fraction observation are appropriate for Grade 5.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_p044 and its prerequisites fit the division fact; cnm_p166 and cnm_p165 fit the fraction observation. Fraction classification correctly remains method-local. The pending route-neutral quotient target is reasonable.
